raw: {"status":"complete","answer":{"question_id":989,"db":"MYSQL","query":"SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ec.company_id) AS company_count FROM energy.energy_company ec JOIN energy.energy_station es ON ec.company_id = es.company_id WHERE ec.area_id LIKE '37%' AND es.station_type_code = 'WP';"},"requirements":[{"requirement":"统计山东省拥有风力发电场的电力企业数量","tables":["MYSQL:energy.energy_company","MYSQL:energy.energy_station"],"columns":["energy_company.company_id","energy_company.area_id","energy_station.company_id","energy_station.station_type_code"]}],"assumptions":["山东省的行政区划代码前两位为37，使用 area_id LIKE '37%' 筛选","风力发电场对应场站类型代码 WP"]}
